subject.title: fix(reef): repeated relay reconnects no longer leave stale sockets active

question: Should Reef intentionally wait for the production `ws` graceful-close deadline—up to roughly 30 seconds—before reconnecting after a locally failed generation whose peer ignores close?
rationale: The patch trades faster recovery for a stronger no-overlap guarantee; source and dependency behavior establish the tradeoff, but the acceptable channel recovery bound is a product and operational decision.

options.title: Accept the native close bound
options.body: Keep the current single-close-event barrier and document the roughly 30-second worst-case reconnect delay as the price of preventing stale-socket overlap.

options.title: Restore a shorter owner-defined bound
options.body: Add an explicitly owned, tested termination policy only if Reef requires faster recovery and can preserve the no-overlap invariant.

recommendation.title: Accept the native close bound
recommendation.body: Keep the current single-close-event barrier and document the roughly 30-second worst-case reconnect delay as the price of preventing stale-socket overlap.
